summary: This document extends signature-based authentication in the Internet Key Exchange Version 2 (IKEv2). IKEv2 had limited support for ECDSA, with only a few elliptic curve groups and a fixed hash algorithm tied to each. This standards-track update lets peers use a wider choice of signature and hash algorithms.

eli5.summary: Two computers prove who they are by signing messages, like signing a letter. This update lets them agree on more kinds of pens and ink, so they are not stuck with just a few.
